SessionStart.command: out=$(node ~/.agents/skills/chains/chain.mjs list --max 5 --hook agy-start 2>/dev/null); case "$out" in "{"*) ;; *) out='{}';; esac; printf '%s\n' "$out"

Stop.command: out=$(node ~/.agents/skills/chains/chain.mjs remind --hook agy-stop 2>/dev/null); case "$out" in "{"*) ;; *) out='{}';; esac; printf '%s\n' "$out"
